title: Circles
examples: Area of a circle with diameter 10 cm
How far round a wheel of radius 30 cm?
Why do we halve the diameter?

explain.say: Every circle has a centre. The radius goes from the centre to the edge, and the diameter goes all the way across, so it is twice the radius.
The distance round a circle is its circumference: two times pi times the radius.
The area is pi times the radius squared. With a radius of 5, that is 25 pi, about 78.5 square centimetres.
The big trap: putting the diameter into the area formula. Always halve the diameter first.

draw.text: Trap: halve the diameter to get the radius

faq: What is the circumference of a circle?
The circumference is the distance all the way round a circle: pi times the diameter, or two pi r.
What is the area of a circle?
The area of a circle is pi times the radius squared.
How are the radius and the diameter related?
The diameter is twice the radius, so the radius is half the diameter.

faq.q: Do I use the radius or the diameter in the area formula?
faq.a: The radius. If you are given the diameter, halve it first.

faq.a: The distance round any circle is a little more than three of its diameters, about 3.14 of them.

faq.q: What does leave your answer in terms of pi mean?
faq.a: Keep pi as a symbol in the answer, like 12 pi, instead of turning it into a decimal.
asks: what does in terms of pi mean
do i have to write pi in the answer

faq: Do I add the flat edge for a semicircle perimeter?
Yes. Half the circumference plus the diameter.
Why is area in square units but circumference in plain units?
The circumference is a length round the edge. The area counts squares inside.

quiz.say: A circle has a radius of 5 centimetres. What is its area, in terms of pi?
quiz.show: Radius 5 cm. What is the area, in terms of π?
quiz.why: Pi r squared: 5 squared is 25, so 25 pi.

wrong.0: That is two pi r, the distance round.
wrong.2: That used the diameter as the radius.

quiz.say: A circle has a diameter of 12 centimetres. What is its circumference, in terms of pi?
quiz.show: Diameter 12 cm. What is the circumference, in terms of π?
quiz.why: The circumference is pi times the diameter: 12 pi centimetres.

wrong.3: That used the radius with pi d.

quiz.say: A semicircle has a diameter of 8 metres. What is its perimeter, in terms of pi?
quiz.show: A semicircle has diameter 8 m. Its perimeter, in terms of π?
quiz.why: Half of 8 pi is 4 pi for the curve, plus the flat edge of 8 metres.

wrong.2: That is the whole circle, and the flat edge is missing.
wrong.3: That used the area formula for the curve.
